backup_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where backup archives will be stored

max_full_backups.description: Maximum number of full backups to retain; older full backups will be deleted

max_incr_backups.description: Maximum number of incremental backups to keep after the last full backup

full_backup_threshold_mb.description: If the amount of changed data since the last full backup exceeds this (in MB), a new full backup is triggered

compress.description: Whether to compress backup archives using gzip

verify.description: Whether to verify backup archives after creation (requires the `tar` command)

include_dirs.description: List of directories to include in every backup

items.description: Absolute path to a directory to include

exclude_patterns.description: List of patterns (fnmatch-style) of files/directories to exclude

tar_opts.description: List of additional command-line options for `tar` (e.g., for filesystem safety)

items.description: A single tar option (without the leading dash)

pre_backup_script.description: Optional absolute path to a script to run before each backup (e.g., to flush DB buffers)

post_backup_script.description: Optional absolute path to a script to run after each backup (e.g., to copy to remote storage)

notify_email.description: Email address to receive backup summaries; empty string disables email notifications

notify_subject_prefix.description: Prefix for email subject lines (useful for mail filtering)

notify_level.description: When to send email: 'error' (only on failure), 'warn' (warnings+errors), 'always' (every run)

log_file.description: Path to the log file; empty string disables file logging (stderr only)
